title.narrative: Enhancing democratic resilience through open society in Indonesia

description.narrative: This project aims to support inclusive governance and institutional collaboration in Indonesia by drawing on relevant expertise from the United Kingdom. It focuses on three key areas: stakeholder engagement, technical assistance, and open government. The first area involves fostering constructive dialogue and collaboration among Parliament, government institutions, and civil society. Through multi-stakeholder discussions and policy exchanges, the project will help strengthen relationships and promote shared learning. A Reform Observatory will be established to provide a platform for civil society to contribute to discussions on governance and electoral processes. Policy dialogues between the United Kingdom and Indonesia will be designed around mutual interests and priorities. The second area provides tailored technical assistance to enhance the capacity of public institutions and civil society on topics such as governance, justice systems, elections, and public accountability. This includes support for evidence-based policymaking through tools like regulatory impact assessments and cost-benefit analyses. The project will also help identify opportunities to improve transparency and access to public information, particularly in the context of electoral data. The third area supports the development of Indonesia’s next Open Government National Action Plan and a broader strategy for open governance. This includes facilitating policy consultations and encouraging collaboration across government bodies to strengthen public service delivery and citizen engagement. Longer-term efforts in this area will be supported through complementary regional initiatives. The project will engage a wide range of stakeholders, including parliamentary bodies, government ministries, political parties, and civil society organisations, ensuring that participation is inclusive and relevant to each area of work.
